definitions.full: H1948. holeluth הוֺלֵלוּת noun feminine id. (formed unusually from the participle, an Aramaic formation, compare Ba NB 414 f. ) רָעָה הוֺלֵלוּת מִּיהוּ וְאַחֲרִית סִכְלוּת דִּבְּרֵיפִֿיהוּ תְּהִּלַּת Eccl 10:13 the beginning of the words of his mouth is folly, and the end of his mouth (his speech) is evil madness. הַלֲלוּיָהֿ הַלֲלוּיָהּ, see הלל Pi`el
